item.title: 'You can't turn off your emotion' — Inside a Ukrainian morgue as war deaths mount
item.description: Four years into Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, experts at the Kharkiv Oblast forensic medical bureau — the oldest in Ukraine and founded in 1797 — continue to work tirelessly in what they see as their battle to bring justice to Ukrainians killed by Russia's war.

item.title: Most of Ukraine remains exposed to Russian ballistic missiles, Zelensky says
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Feb. 23 that about 80% of Ukraine lacks protection against Russian ballistic missiles, renewing calls for additional air defense systems, including Patriots.

item.title: 'Our sacrifices are worth freedom' — Ukrainian troops who have fought since 2014 look back
item.description: Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine four years ago today — Feb. 24, 2022. item.title: Canada announces $1.4 billion military aid package for Ukraine, expands sanctions against Russia
item.description: Canada announced a C$2 billion ($1.4 billion) military aid package for Ukraine on Feb. 24 and expanded sanctions against Russia, including measures targeting Moscow’s “shadow fleet” and a lower oil price cap.

item.title: US abstains from UN vote on 'lasting peace in Ukraine' on 4th anniversary of war
item.description: "Is not missing children, shelling of cities, and the killing of innocents enough? It is not a business deal — it is war," former Special Envoy Keith Kellogg said in a scathing post after the vote.

item.title: US, Ukraine to hold talks in Geneva Feb. 26, Trump envoy says
item.description: Witkoff said he would meet with Ukraine's security chief Rustem Umerov on Feb. 26, though the primary purpose of his visit would be negotiations with Iran.

item.title: Russia's Transneft cuts oil intake after Ukrainian strike on Druzhba pipeline hub, Reuters reports
item.description: Damage from the attack forced Transneft to cut crude oil intake by 250,000 barrels per day and could cause further problems for Russian oil exports, affecting volumes and quality of oil shipped, industry sources told Reuters.

item.title: As Russia rained missiles on Ukrainian cities last fall, US issued warning to Kyiv over Black Sea drone strike, ambassador says
item.description: The U.S. State Department warned Ukraine in November 2025 that its strike on Russia's Novorossiysk port threatened American economic interests.
